notablePrerequisites: You have at least two land cards in hand.
description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its retrace cost by discarding a land card.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Tilling Treefolk from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {2}{G} and discarding a land card.
When Tilling Treefolk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning two land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tilling Treefolk, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
